repairs.summary: Rephrased the Perfekt usage rule to describe frequent use for past events rather than the unnatural 'Vergangenheitsaussage bilden' formulation.
Restricted the Ortswechsel heuristic to intransitive verbs to avoid overgeneralizing sein selection.
Removed 'bezahlt' from the ge-regular examples and moved it to the inseparable-prefix rule, where it belongs.
Corrected the modal Präteritum rule from calling konnte/musste/etc. stems to the actual stems plus weak past endings.
Clarified the source's wollte contrast without presenting möchten as having its own Präteritum paradigm.
Replaced a grammatical-but-less-typical Perfekt sentence that had been mislabeled as wrong with a genuinely tense-mismatched past sentence.
Removed the overbroad 'obligatorily reflexive' label and tied reflexivity to the intended constructions.
Limited reflexive-pronoun position guidance to pronominal subjects instead of stating an overgeneral rule.
Made reciprocal sich unambiguous with 'ineinander', repaired the related exercise and improved Persian translation of sich auf etwas freuen.
Removed standalone 'von Montag' as a start-time pattern; reserved ab for start and von...bis for a span.
